body:
In seventh grade, on a night ski trip to [[wiki/places/seven-springs|Seven
Springs]], Dan's girlfriend attempted to give him oral sex in the woods between
two trails, discovered he had not yet begun puberty, and abandoned the attempt.
By the following school day the story had spread through
Laurel Highlands Middle School, and he spent
**the next full year** being called **"Bald Eagle"** — sometimes extended to
"Bald Eagle Cummings" — by the older students. It is the earliest sexual event
anywhere in the corpus, and the record of it is a humiliation rather than an
experience.

Dan's own framing of the relationship that produced it is the part with the
longest reach. The girlfriend was, in his words, the prettiest girl in the
class, and he introduces her by saying this was *"my first experience with
something i would go through many times — somehow getting a girl way above my
level to date me."* **The pattern the adult record documents repeatedly is
named by him at its first occurrence, in the seventh grade.**

The account comes from a single operator capture written in 2026, roughly
twenty-five years after the fact, and is marked `knowledge: mixed` accordingly.
Nothing in it is independently corroborated.

## Why he was the youngest person in the room

Two facts compound, and the capture states both plainly:

| Factor | Detail |
| :--- | :--- |
| Started school early | Began a year ahead, so he was *"always a full year or more younger than his classmates"* |
| Late development | *"genetically a late bloomer"* — at 38 he still cannot grow a full beard |
| State at the time | *"fully and completely yet to start the process of puberty"* |
| Understanding | Barely familiar with the term; sexual gratification *"was still a concept that had yet to click"* |

That combination is the whole event. A twelve-year-old a year young for his
grade, physically pre-adolescent, in a relationship with the most socially
prominent girl in the class, is placed in a sexual situation he does not
understand and cannot physically participate in — and the failure is then
narrated back to him by an entire school. **He did not know what had happened,
why it was bad, or what it predicted**, which is his own summary of it.

## The geography is not incidental

The ski club ran seven or eight trips a year: a school bus up for the
after-school session, everyone back aboard by 9 p.m. when the lifts closed.
**Dan did not ride the bus.** His family had a season pass for him before he
turned one, rented a condo every winter, and eventually bought unit K2 in the
Sunridge development of the Villages at Seven Springs — ski-in, ski-out. So
instead of the supervised trip, he selected a group of friends,
[[wiki/people/suzanne-frank|Suz]] drove them, and they used the condo as a base,
skiing later with *"less restrictions and no technical school supervision."*

That access asymmetry is what put four unsupervised twelve-to-fourteen-year-olds
on the mountain after the school group had gone home. The party that night was
Dan, his friend **Victor Fiano**, the girlfriend **Britney Bolen**, and Britney's
cousin **Alan**, two years older. The site was the undeveloped, ungroomed woods
between the green trail *Boomerang* and the residential access trail running up
from the lower Villages — terrain reachable because they were staying in it.

## The aftermath, and the second humiliation

The nickname ran for a year, and it came from **older kids** — the cohort he was
already a year behind by grade and further behind by development.

The capture closes with a second injury that Dan reports learning later: on the
drive home, in Suz's Chrysler Town and Country minivan, Victor Fiano sat in the
back with Britney and *"got his fingers wet."* Dan's reading of it, written in
2026, attributes this to her frustration after the failed attempt. Whatever the
cause, the structure of the evening is that the friend in the car succeeded in
the same hour, in the same vehicle, at the thing Dan had publicly failed at —
and that Dan found out afterwards.

## What this dates

**The first girlfriend is not Danielle.** [[wiki/places/seven-springs]] and
[[wiki/people/danielle-onesi]] both treat the 2004 Danielle relationship as the
first documented one. Britney Bolen predates it by roughly three years and is
now the earliest named partner in the record.

**The ski crew has names.** That page carried a standing gap — *"any named
individuals from the Seven Springs crew beyond the general cohort
description."* The capture closes it: [[wiki/people/jerad-friedline|Jerad
Friedline]], [[wiki/people/josh-brannan|Josh Brannan]] and Jon Allen were all
met through skiing, and Dan states directly that *"most of my best friends were
not from Laurel Highlands where i went to school, but from skiing at
7Springs."* His primary peer network was formed twenty-five miles from the
place he was educated, on weekends, inside a property his family owned.

**The condo question has a shape.** [[wiki/mind/synthesis/fayette-return]]
flagged [[wiki/people/morley-frank|Morley]]'s 1996–99 Champion, Pennsylvania
directory listings as a documented co-occurrence with Dan's recorded weekly ski
identity, with the causal link explicitly unestablished. The capture does not
establish it either, but it changes what is being asked: the family rented at
the resort for years before purchasing K2, and Champion is the resort's town.
Whether Morley's Champion address was that rental, a separate property, or the
unit later purchased is now a specific, checkable question rather than a vague
adjacency. It is still not answered.

## Gaps

- **The date is unfixed.** Seventh grade for a student who started a year early
  puts it around the 2000–01 school year, but the capture says only "7th grade"
  and "one winter day." Nothing narrows it further.
- **Britney Bolen, Victor Fiano, Alan and Jon Allen have no other presence in
  the corpus.** None appears in any message export, Facebook archive or dossier
  located so far. Whether any of them remained in contact is unknown — which
  makes this cohort a direct test of [[wiki/mind/synthesis/dormancy-not-exit]]'s
  no-exit rule at the earliest point the record reaches.
- **The nickname is unattested outside this capture.** A year of school-wide use
  should have left traces in the 2007-era Facebook archive; nobody has looked.
- **The second-hand claim about Victor and Britney in the minivan** is reported
  as something Dan *"later found out"* and is not corroborated.
